timeline.title: LTTS jumps ~15% on strong Q2
timeline.line: Net profit ₹548.2 cr, up 66.8% YoY, beat estimates; shares hit ₹4,143 on NSE.
more: Growth led by sustainability segment and large-deal execution
Management expects another year of double-digit growth there
Some reports cite 53.5% profit growth; ₹548 cr is consistent
